minutes.headline: Board members want to withhold the final school-project payment over unresolved HVAC and roof questions
minutes.summary: The Select Board heard the school building committee close out the middle-high school project, reported as delivered under budget, and the finance director explained the remaining borrowing. Members questioned releasing the final contractor payment while HVAC problems continue and asked for the facilities director to attend. The board also moved to accept the town manager's annual evaluation, discussed a social media policy, and reviewed the upcoming budget meeting calendar.

what_happened.line: The Select Board agreed to keep withholding the final school-project payment and to have the facilities director attend to explain HVAC and roof issues.
The building committee reported the middle-high school project as finished under budget; the town share is estimated below the funding agreement, pending the MSBA's final decision.
The finance director said a bond anticipation note falls due in January 2019, when the final bond would be issued, and that rates may rise.
A motion to accept the town manager's evaluation as read and amended was made; the minutes record the outcome as not audible.
The board set the town manager salary executive session for February 6, a part-workshop meeting for February 13, and added a social media policy to the workshop topics.

why_it_matters: The final contractor payment and the size of the last bond decide how much of the school project the town borrows for and pays back through taxes, and bond rates may be higher when the note comes due.
Unresolved HVAC and roof questions in a new school building bear on whether repair costs fall on the town after the project is closed out.
watch_next: February 6 meeting: executive session on the town manager's salary.
Facilities director's appearance before the board on HVAC and roof issues, and the MSBA's final decision on the town share.
